initialPrompts.medicine:
Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 static illustration, 1920x1080 composition, for an original animated educational film. This is an artwork consistency test, not a poster, not a thumbnail or a character sheet. No lettering whatsoever, no logos, captions, titles, labels, borders or watermarks.

VISUAL BASELINE: Look closely at both attached approved original production illustrations. Preserve their level of drawing sophistication: confident large curved silhouettes, rich but controlled purple/teal/coral/gold color families, distinct shaped color planes, soft restrained internal gradient shading, beautifully composed layered environments, no harsh black outlines. Humans have dimensional rounded cheeks, small solid dark oval eyes WITHOUT whites or glints, sculpted masses of hair, expressive brows, convincing charming hands, simple clean anatomy, and beautifully constructed clothing. This must feel like another scene from the same original animated world. Do not copy the reference characters or cafe environment. No photorealism, painterly brush marks, sketch lines, plastic 3D render, anime eyes, or generic flat stock-vector people.

SCENE / STORY: A tiny infection and the immense work of the immune system. Stage a welcoming, beautifully illustrated medical research clinic at evening. The main human is an ORIGINAL older female clinician, entirely different from the references: warm terracotta/brown skin stylized through coral/plum shadows, a distinctive compact crown of tight silver-white curls, rounded friendly nose and substantial soft cheeks, small dark violet oval eyes, clear calm focused expression. She wears a well-constructed ivory lab coat with rolled cuffs over deep jade scrubs, purple trousers, and simple coral shoes. Three-quarter view, seated naturally on a rounded low stool on the RIGHT third of the image, leaning toward a real microscope on a broad curved workbench, one anatomically clean hand resting at the focus knob and the other gently holding a glass specimen slide by its edge. Her posture visibly communicates curiosity and care. Her entire face must be readable at scene scale. Avoid giant eyeglasses obscuring the face. Make her a striking, memorable well-drawn new human character, not a recolored young character.

The LEFT two thirds are dominated by a generous organic circular microscope-view display built into the clinic wall behind the bench: an enormously enlarged, richly illustrated microscopic scene, clear and legible rather than a technical HUD. Inside the microscope view a curved blood vessel carries a few beautiful flattened red blood cells through a deep berry environment; one large ivory/lilac immune cell wraps broad soft lobes around two small teal spiky bacteria. More distant red blood cells recede into plum depth. The organic shapes have meticulous clear silhouettes and colored shaded planes, not goo, glitter, noise or realistic gore. This is a friendly explanatory view of immune defense. The microscope and its large simple viewing screen make the relation between the clinician and the microscopic world understandable, with a single neat cable physically connecting them. Screen rim is a simple dark plum architectural curve, no charts, numbers, menus, interface grids, unnecessary decorative rings or floating holographic shards.

COMPOSITION: a single coherent cinematic room, with the softly lit clinician face, her hands/microscope and the giant immune cell forming a three-point visual path. Strong deliberate hierarchy: immune cell first, clinician second, smaller medical objects third. Beautiful foreground bench edge, small glass culture dish with one red droplet, a capped pipette tray, curved microscope base, subtly lit drawers, a low round pot with broad leaves, large window showing sunset rooftops and distant blue hills. Include foreground-midground-background depth, tasteful cast shadows, curved floor lighting, careful warm/cool contrast. Keep secondary objects quieter, with breathing room around her face and around the immune cell. All objects should support this scene; no random pills, giant pill bottle, stock medical crosses, syringe pile, hazard signs, or decorative medical icons. Excellent distinct planes and overlaps, clean uncluttered edges. Detailed enough to reward inspection, unified and readable at full-frame size. Full-bleed, finished animation artwork.
initialPrompts.cyber:
Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 static scene illustration, 1920x1080 composition, for an original animated educational film. This is a rich narrative environment, not a poster, thumbnail, dashboard, icon sheet or infographic. Absolutely NO humans, humanoids, human silhouettes, faces, mascots or anthropomorphic robots. Absolutely NO lettering, numbers, binary code, logos, captions, titles, labels, borders or watermarks.

VISUAL BASELINE: The attached approved original production frame is a QUALITY / ILLUSTRATION-GRAMMAR reference only. Match its refined 2D drawing, sculpted curved silhouettes, coherent shaped shading, subtle gradients within otherwise crisp color planes, carefully composed foreground-midground-background layers, warm focal light against cooler deep purple architecture, and rich environmental detail with clean value grouping. Create a completely new subject and palette; do not include its people, clothing, cafe, pots or sunset village. No photorealism, game render, shiny plastic 3D, painterly brushwork, sketch marks, thick black outlines, generic neon cyberpunk city, glow overload or flat corporate stock illustration.

SCENE / STORY: Inside a network during an attempted intrusion. Depict a magnificent miniature communications world built ON and INSIDE a large cutaway router / circuit board, seen from an elegant slightly elevated three-quarter cinematic angle, with enough side view to make the architecture dramatic. The foreground bottom-left reveals three beautifully drawn rounded physical Ethernet sockets and the cutaway layers of a dark indigo circuit board, with gold traces and thick neatly routed cables creating depth. Their circuitry becomes broad physical data pathways leading diagonally into a small city of original curved server towers, layered storage cylinders and cooling structures in the rear right. Architecture is designed and beautiful, not a generic motherboard photo.

The main focal point at center-left is a substantial WARM AMBER NETWORK GATE: two thick rounded gateway pylons and a simple curved translucent gold barrier spanning a blue-green data causeway. It is a physical infrastructural object, not a floating shield/padlock logo or magic spell. Clean turquoise/cream rectangular data blocks pass neatly through a separate open approved lane into the city. A short, distinct stream of sharp coral/magenta irregular data shards approaches the protected lane; the gold gate diverts those shards along an arcing side channel INTO a clearly isolated sunken coral quarantine basin in the lower-right middle distance, separated from the clean route by a dark gap. The malicious stream must visibly end in containment rather than reach the server city. Shape/color and the clear continuous paths explain the story with no text. Make the amount of traffic selective and readable, not thousands of tiny neon particles. No arrows, floating HUD panels, generic cybersecurity clip-art, code rain or giant screens.

Build a beautiful layered environment around this action: larger dark foreground cable loops framing the bottom corner, a crisp detailed gateway in the middle ground, smaller cool teal server buildings receding toward the rear right, arched fiber-optic bridges over deep navy board channels, tiny warm maintenance lights, quiet vents and fans, a distant curved circuit ridge fading into muted violet depth. Wide composition, strong asymmetry, sweeping curved paths leading the eye from input sockets to gateway to secure city, then to the isolated threat basin. Use a sophisticated deep midnight-blue / indigo / jade palette, mint clean traffic, amber successful protection and small restrained coral accents for the intrusion. Soft warm pools of light and purposeful cast shadows, subtle illustrated glow only where needed. Crisp tactile 2D planes, strong large silhouettes, varied object scales, enough detail for a long-form explainer keyframe while maintaining clean negative space around the gate. No explosions or action movie clutter. Full-bleed finished animation artwork.
